nodes.name: generate-ignore.mjs
nodes.summary: Node.js CLI script that generates a starter .understand-anything/.understandignore file for a project by delegating to generateStarterIgnoreFile from @understand-anything/core.
nodes.languageNotes: ESM module using dynamic import for @understand-anything/core resolution with workspace-link and dist fallback.

nodes.name: resolvePluginRoot
nodes.summary: Resolves the plugin root directory from the PLUGIN_ROOT environment variable or falls back to a relative path from __dirname.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure function with early return for env var check before filesystem fallback.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Main execution: resolves plugin root, imports @understand-anything/core, calls generateStarterIgnoreFile, and writes the output to .understand-anything/.understandignore.
nodes.languageNotes: Top-level await using ESM dynamic import pattern with try/catch fallback for module resolution.

nodes.name: Gin Framework Addendum
nodes.summary: Framework addendum injected into file-analyzer and architecture-analyzer prompts when Gin is detected. Documents canonical file roles, edge patterns, architectural layers, and notable patterns for Go Gin projects.
nodes.languageNotes: Structured markdown with canonical file role tables, edge pattern descriptions, layer definitions, and language lesson templates.

nodes.name: Next.js Framework Addendum
nodes.summary: Framework addendum injected into prompts when Next.js is detected. Covers App Router file conventions, canonical file roles, edge patterns for layout nesting, API routes, and server/client component boundaries.
nodes.languageNotes: Structured markdown documenting App Router conventions, parallel routes, route groups, and Server Component architecture.

nodes.name: Rails Framework Addendum
nodes.summary: Framework addendum injected into prompts when Ruby on Rails is detected. Documents canonical file roles, ActiveRecord associations, route-to-controller mappings, and Rails conventions.
nodes.languageNotes: Structured markdown covering Rails MVC conventions, ActiveRecord patterns, callbacks, and concern-based modularity.

nodes.name: React Framework Addendum
nodes.summary: Framework addendum injected into prompts when React is detected. Documents component composition, hook usage, context provider/consumer patterns, and architectural layers for React projects.
nodes.languageNotes: Structured markdown with edge patterns for component composition, hook dependencies, and props drilling chains.

nodes.name: Spring Boot Framework Addendum
nodes.summary: Framework addendum injected into prompts when Spring Boot is detected. Covers canonical file roles, @Autowired dependency injection patterns, Controller-Service-Repository chain, and JPA entity relationships.
nodes.languageNotes: Structured markdown documenting Spring Boot layered architecture, annotation-driven development patterns, and AOP concepts.

nodes.name: Vue Framework Addendum
nodes.summary: Framework addendum injected into prompts when Vue is detected. Documents component parent-child composition, composable usage, store actions, router view mappings, and architectural layers.
nodes.languageNotes: Structured markdown covering Composition API, Pinia stores, Vue Router navigation guards, and single-file component patterns.

nodes.name: C++ Language Prompt Snippet
nodes.summary: Language reference snippet for C++ analysis. Documents templates, RAII, smart pointers, move semantics, and import patterns including #include directives.
nodes.languageNotes: Structured markdown with key concepts, import patterns, file patterns, common frameworks, and example language notes.

nodes.name: C# Language Prompt Snippet
nodes.summary: Language reference snippet for C# analysis. Documents LINQ, async/await, generics, nullable reference types, and ASP.NET Core framework conventions.
nodes.languageNotes: Structured markdown with key concepts, using directives, file patterns, and common frameworks like ASP.NET Core and Entity Framework.

nodes.name: CSS Language Prompt Snippet
nodes.summary: Language reference snippet for CSS analysis. Documents selectors, specificity, box model, flexbox, grid, custom properties, and SCSS/Sass features.
nodes.languageNotes: Non-code language snippet with edge patterns for CSS file relationships, SCSS partial dependencies, and CSS Modules.

nodes.name: Dockerfile Language Prompt Snippet
nodes.summary: Language reference snippet for Dockerfile analysis. Documents multi-stage builds, layer caching, base images, build arguments, health checks, and docker-compose patterns.
nodes.languageNotes: Non-code language snippet with edge patterns for Dockerfile deploys, docker-compose depends_on, and build dependency relationships.

nodes.name: Go Language Prompt Snippet
nodes.summary: Language reference snippet for Go analysis. Documents goroutines, channels, interfaces, struct embedding, error handling, and import patterns.
nodes.languageNotes: Structured markdown covering Go's concurrency model, interface satisfaction, internal package enforcement, and common frameworks like Gin and Echo.

nodes.name: GraphQL Language Prompt Snippet
nodes.summary: Language reference snippet for GraphQL analysis. Documents type system, queries, mutations, subscriptions, resolvers, fragments, and schema federation.
nodes.languageNotes: Non-code language snippet with edge patterns for schema definitions, resolver implementations, and code generation pipelines.

nodes.name: HTML Language Prompt Snippet
nodes.summary: Language reference snippet for HTML analysis. Documents semantic elements, forms, accessibility, meta tags, Web Components, and template syntax patterns.
nodes.languageNotes: Non-code language snippet with edge patterns for HTML dependencies on CSS/JS files and server-side template rendering.

nodes.name: Java Language Prompt Snippet
nodes.summary: Language reference snippet for Java analysis. Documents generics, annotations, streams, lambdas, sealed classes, dependency injection, and Spring Boot conventions.
nodes.languageNotes: Structured markdown covering Java 17+ features, Maven/Gradle directory layout, checked vs unchecked exceptions, and common frameworks.

nodes.name: JavaScript Language Prompt Snippet
nodes.summary: Language reference snippet for JavaScript analysis. Documents closures, prototypes, promises, event loop, ESM vs CJS module systems, and common frameworks.
nodes.languageNotes: Structured markdown covering ESM and CommonJS module patterns, destructuring, spread operators, and closure-based module patterns.

nodes.name: JSON Language Prompt Snippet
nodes.summary: Language reference snippet for JSON analysis. Documents strict syntax rules, JSON Schema, JSONC, JSON5, and notable file patterns like package.json and tsconfig.json.
nodes.languageNotes: Non-code language snippet with edge patterns for JSON config files that configure build tools, compilers, and runtime behavior.

nodes.name: Kotlin Language Prompt Snippet
nodes.summary: Language reference snippet for Kotlin analysis. Documents coroutines, data classes, sealed classes, extension functions, null safety, and Ktor/Spring Boot conventions.
nodes.languageNotes: Structured markdown covering Kotlin-specific features like coroutines, Flow, scope functions, and Gradle Kotlin DSL build files.

nodes.name: Markdown Language Prompt Snippet
nodes.summary: Language reference snippet for Markdown analysis. Documents heading hierarchy, front matter, fenced code blocks, reference-style links, and edge patterns for documentation-to-code relationships.
nodes.languageNotes: Non-code language snippet with edge patterns for documents relationships between markdown files and the code components they describe.

nodes.name: PHP Language Prompt Snippet
nodes.summary: Language reference snippet for PHP analysis. Documents namespaces, traits, type declarations, attributes, enums, fibers, and Laravel/Symfony conventions.
nodes.languageNotes: Structured markdown covering PHP 8 features, PSR-4 autoloading, Composer dependency management, and common frameworks like Laravel and Symfony.

nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Project-specific ignore patterns for file analysis exclusions. Generated by generate-ignore.mjs with commented-out test file pattern suggestions organized by language.
nodes.languageNotes: Line-oriented text file following .gitignore syntax with commented-out suggestions for JS/TS, C#, Java/Kotlin, and Go test patterns.
